purpose: Fill high-value artisan training and region-unlock gaps for Equilibrium planning: Smithing outfit/tools and burial pipeline, Construction/Cooking/Crafting ironman routes, and Firemaking curly-roots ceiling when Superheat Form (Tirannwn prayer) is available. Methods are base-game ironman-relevant rates; region labels use Equilibrium/official or working Catalyst locality mappings already used in this repo.

methods.method: Burial armour / burial sets at Artisans' Workshop
methods.location: Artisans' Workshop, Falador (eastern burial wing from 40 Smithing)
methods.importance: Primary ironman Smithing XP spine: highest-tier burial sets destroy the product for +50% XP/bar, then set bonus; train at Artisans' Workshop for respect and luminite injector buffs.
methods.throughput: Can exceed 1,000,000 XP/h; ideal stacked setups exceed 4,000,000 XP/h off DXP per main training guide framing.
ironman_notes: Do not pre-smelt all bars; smelt as needed until double-bar chance level for that metal.
Skip orikalkum for ironmen when rune is faster after mining time; primal only when Mining is high enough.
Corrupted ore is no longer competitive vs bane/elder rune for pure XP; use only if free from other content.

methods.method: Blacksmith's outfit (respect priority)
methods.location: Artisans' Workshop Reward Shop, Falador
methods.importance: Highest XP-per-respect spend: full outfit is 6% Smithing XP (1% per piece + 1% set). Helmet add-on adds 1% double bars while smelting and Artisans' Workshop teleport.
methods.respect_priority: Buy full blacksmith's outfit (incl. headgear) first — 300% respect / ~3M burial-equivalent XP — before solemn smith and ceremonial upgrades.
methods.emphasis: Burial smithing already exists as the Asgarnia method; outfit is the missing permanent amplifier that should be planned as a first respect dump, not an optional cosmetic.

methods.method: Crystal hammer (augmentable)
methods.location: Sing at Ithell singing bowl (Prifddinas) or pay Tirannwn crystal rechargers
methods.importance: 1% chance of double progress on smithing swings; best base for Tinker/Rapid/Breakdown Invention perks once augmented.
requirements: 150 harmonic dust + 80 Smithing to sing, OR coins via Ilfeen/Eluned/Islwyn/Rhodri Dail
Plague's End / Prifddinas for free singing path; Roving Elves path for paid convert
methods.league_note: Harmonic dust is also a Construction/Crafting side product on harps — Tirannwn double-dips artisan planning.

methods.method: Superheat Form (Seren prayer) while smelting/smithing
methods.location: Prayer unlock from The Light Within; usable anywhere once unlocked
methods.importance: Smelting 1 tick faster; low/medium heat treated as medium/high — major AFK and throughput upgrade for burial smithing.
sustain_notes: Grace of the elves (Tirannwn) halves drain; Dark Facet of Grace can null it.
Orthen furnace core (Anachronia craft) fully stops Superheat Form prayer drain when equipped before activating the prayer.

methods.method: Smithing autoheater / Advanced smithing autoheater
methods.location: Daemonheim Rewards (Marmaros); Equilibrium maps Daemonheim to Forinthry/Wilderness
methods.importance: AFK heat: base autoheater spends 5 coal for 30% heat at 0%; advanced spends 50 coal for 60% heat. Paired with Superheat Form, heat can stay medium-high with almost no reheat clicks.
requirements: Advanced: 70 Smithing + 70 Dungeoneering, 40,000 tokens (upgrades the basic unit)
methods.league_note: Hard region dependency: no-trading ironman/league cannot buy the pocket item without Daemonheim token access.

methods.method: Orthen furnace core — obtain (craft)
methods.location: Crafted on anvil (masterwork tab); dragon burners excavated at Orthen Observation outpost
methods.importance: Top-end Smithing/Firemaking off-hand. Obtain path is Anachronia Archaeology-heavy, not Tirannwn-only.
requirements: 102 Archaeology (boostable for craft; untradeable masterwork ingredients cannot be assisted)
4 restored dragon burners from Orthen experiment workbench digs
Masterwork plate chain (curved masterwork melee plates), vital sparks, stone spirits, tarromin incense, etc.
secondary_material_regions: Global bar/ore bank for alloy chain

methods.method: Orthen furnace core — use (equipped)
methods.location: Anywhere while smithing/firemaking/woodcutting with Superheat Form
methods.importance: Stops Superheat Form prayer drain; Breakdown can grant 5% Smithing/Firemaking XP buff (Furnace Core) for 5 minutes; scroll of efficiency 2% → 2.5%; forge phoenix spawns.
methods.region_combo_notes: Craft needs Anachronia (Orthen) + 99 Smithing infrastructure; full value needs Tirannwn Superheat Form (The Light Within). Autoheater (Forinthry) is the third piece of the AFK smith stack.
methods.league_note: Track as Anachronia+Tirannwn combo unlock; do not treat as pure-XP BIS vs every augmented off-hand setup.

methods.method: Fort Forinthry building tiers + quest series
methods.location: Fort Forinthry (working League taxonomy: Catalyst Misthalin; Equilibrium boundary not re-published)
methods.importance: Ironman Construction spine: New Foundations → tier upgrades → maple buildings (Miscellania maple) → magic buildings. Workshop first for XP, Town Hall for rested XP.
ironman_notes: Portable workbenches cannot be used in Ironman Mode.
Boosts only needed to start blueprints.
Hardwood from Managing Miscellania (Fremennik questline) feeds teak/mahogany and maple Fort loops.

methods.method: Construction contracts (teak → mahogany)
methods.location: Estate agents (e.g. Ithell/Prifddinas restock loop highly efficient); contracts buildable at assigned houses
methods.importance: Best ironman AFK Construction: ~10k base XP/contract + furniture XP, lower plank burn than flatpacks. Teak contracts ~250k+ XP/h at 60+; mahogany can exceed ~625k XP/h with full plank-box upgrades.
ironman_notes: Plank box upgrades and Beast of Burden before max box are critical.
NPC Contact (Lunar, 67 Magic) or attuned crystal teleport seed to Ithell speeds restock.
Constructor's outfit from Temple Trekking (Morytania) is the permanent XP set.
methods.region_combo_notes: Contracts are global once unlocked; Tirannwn speeds restock/teleports; Morytania supplies constructor's outfit; plank supply often Fremennik Miscellania or Kandarin/Ape Atoll woodcutting.

methods.method: Ithell harps (incidental Construction XP while gathering harmonic dust)
methods.location: Prifddinas Ithell district, Voice of Seren preferred
methods.level_range: 75-80 bridge (ironman guide framing) / ongoing while farming crystal tools
methods.importance: After Plague's End, harp play yields Construction XP as a side effect of ~15k harmonic dust targets for crystal tools — not a pure Construction grind but a high-value Tirannwn artisan multi-skill node.

methods.method: Driftwood / Flotsam prawnbroker flatpacks
methods.location: POH workshop flatpacks
methods.importance: Late ironman Construction sink when hardwood/miscellania supply is strong; listed on ironman Construction guide as 63-99 / 73-99 options.

methods.method: Player bonfire + Fort Forinthry tier-3 kitchen
methods.location: Fort Forinthry kitchen (tier 3 needs 85 Construction) with player-built bonfire
methods.level_range: any cookable food; best once kitchen is tier 3
methods.importance: Optimal ironman cook XP stack: player bonfires +10% vs range; Fort kitchen +5% at tier 3 — they stack. Pre-built bonfires (Prif, Menaphos, Yeti Town, Rogues' Den) do not give the +10%.
requirements: Partial Murder on the Border for Fort kitchen path

methods.method: Menaphos port fish (desert sole / catfish / beltfish) catch + cook
methods.location: Menaphos fishing spots near bank
methods.level_range: 52 sole / 60 catfish / 72 beltfish Cooking; burn stops 81/86/90 with cooking gauntlets
methods.importance: Core mid-level ironman food + Cooking XP: one banked spot yields multiple food tiers for Slayer and training.
related_unlocks: Cooking gauntlets (Family Crest) — high priority early
Sous chef's outfit (Gnome Restaurant, Kandarin) — 6% Cooking XP

methods.method: Swarm fishing + boss raw fish banks
methods.location: Deep Sea Fishing hub swarm; cook at Fort/Prif/Max guild as available
methods.level_range: high Cooking; many swarm foods burn until 94-99 gauntlets/cape
methods.importance: Late ironman food for bossing; Cooking XP is secondary to food stock. Heart of Gielinor generals / Croesus / high bosses dump raw sharks/rocktails.

methods.method: Dairy churn cheese / cream cheese with Player-Owned Farm totems
methods.location: Dairy churns + POF cow pens (Manor Farm)
methods.level_range: low Cooking start; 49/71 Farming and 60 Construction for double/quadruple XP totems
methods.importance: Low-risk ironman XP: 64 base XP/bucket (cheese wheel), 80 cream cheese after Chef's Assistant; ×2/×4 with elder cows + farm totems; full sous chef can push ~215k XP/h at low coin cost.

methods.method: Bait and Switch relic (auto-cook catch at 50% Cooking XP)
methods.importance: Not a primary grind (doubles time fishing for full Cooking XP) but strong low-intensity when raw fish comes from PVM or shark outfit consume mode.

methods.method: Crafteneering (Dungeon Smuggler leather loop)
methods.location: Daemonheim floors — buy protomastyx hide + thread, craft protoleather bodies, sell back
methods.importance: Early-mid ironman Crafting without surface materials; benefits from artisan + gatherer kinship roles and scroll of gathering.

methods.method: Uncommon gem rocks + gold necklace production (porter loop)
methods.location: Al Kharid / gem rocks; smelt/craft at Fort Forinthry for rested XP
methods.importance: Self-supplied ironman midgame: cut gems for porters; concentrated gold (80 Mining) + emerald necklaces → Sign of the porter IV (68 Divination) closes the resource loop.

methods.method: Ithell harps (harmonic dust + Crafting XP)
methods.location: Prifddinas Ithell, Voice of Seren preferred
methods.importance: Classic high-level ironman Crafting AFK after Plague's End; simultaneously feeds crystal tools (hammer, hatchet, pickaxe, etc.).

methods.method: Dream of Iaia tannery (Anachronia base-camp hide workers)
methods.location: Anachronia base camp → Dream of Iaia
methods.importance: Best ironman Crafting XP per played-hour: workers on hides ~720 XP/day each; 60/65/70 workers ≈ 43.2k / 46.8k / 50.4k XP/day with command centre tiers — faster than harps for active time.

methods.method: Gate of Elidinis moonstone fragment AFK
methods.location: Gate of Elidinis (Ode of the Devourer / City of Um access path)
methods.importance: Skilling-boss Crafting: AFK moonstone fragments can exceed ~300k XP/h at 99 with sustain setup; conduit repair reduces damage for longer sessions.
methods.league_note: City of Um / Gate use historical Catalyst Misthalin working mapping until Equilibrium publishes a locality override.

methods.method: Bonfire log burning (Yeti Town / Prif / Max Guild)
methods.location: Yeti Town permanent bonfire (Violet is Blue, +4% as 5-player); Prif Tower of Voices (log save chance); Max Guild
methods.importance: Default ironman Firemaking: Miscellania maple/teak/mahogany passive logs; magic logs from bosses. Always prefer permanent high-bonus bonfires.

methods.method: Curly roots (Jadinko Lair firepits)
methods.location: Jadinko Lair, south-eastern Karamja
methods.importance: Baseline high-end free Firemaking: chop curly jade roots, burn in lair firepits. ~250k FM XP/h min; ~305k FM + ~90k WC at high level with Nature's Sentinel + Ring of Fire; also ~1,100 Jadinko favour/h.

methods.method: Curly roots with Superheat Form (or Always Adze)
methods.location: Jadinko Lair — Superheat Form auto-burns roots while chopping
methods.level_range: 83+ FM/WC; 91 Prayer + The Light Within for Superheat Form
methods.importance: Ceiling method: ~670k Firemaking XP/h and ~120k Woodcutting XP/h with Flame gloves + Ring of Fire + Superheat Form (or Always Adze relic). No Jadinko favour on this variant. Ironman guide frames this as the high-level best XP route.
methods.dependency: Superheat Form is a Tirannwn Seren prayer unlock — curly roots sit in Karamja but the XP ceiling is a Tirannwn prayer dependency (sustain via Grace of the elves / Orthen furnace core).
methods.region_combo_notes: Karamja = method site; Tirannwn = Superheat Form (The Light Within) + often Grace of the elves sustain; Anachronia = Orthen furnace core for zero prayer drain. Always Adze relic can substitute Superheat Form without prayer drain.

methods.method: 'Accidental' Firemaking (Extinction products)
methods.location: Post-Extinction accidental FM methods producing shell shards / fungal shafts / dinosaur propellant
methods.importance: Ironman-friendly: Firemaking XP while crafting useful combat/skilling products with no log input; gated by Extinction grandmaster quest.

methods.method: Vyrelord auto-cremation (Sunspear)
methods.location: Darkmeyer vyrelords
methods.level_range: 76+ after Lord of Vampyrium; River of Blood for reforged Sunspear auto-cremate
methods.importance: Passive multi-skill: ~150 FM XP/kill; roughly 70k-200k FM XP/h depending on kill rate, plus combat/prayer/farming/invention side XP.

unlock_notes.title: Asgarnia owns burial Smithing + Blacksmith outfit
unlock_notes.summary: Artisans' Workshop is the ironman Smithing home. Plan respect first into Blacksmith outfit (6% XP + helmet double-bar/teleport), then solemn smith and ceremonial upgrades. Burial sets 40+ are the training method; the outfit is the permanent amplifier often under-specified when only burial is listed.

unlock_notes.title: Tirannwn artisan stack: Superheat Form + crystal hammer + harps
unlock_notes.summary: The Light Within unlocks Superheat Form (91 Prayer) for Smithing heat/smelt speed and Firemaking curly-roots ceiling. Crystal hammer is sung/recharged in Prif/Tirannwn. Harps simultaneously train Crafting (and side Construction) while producing harmonic dust for crystal tools. Grace of the elves sustains Superheat Form drain.

unlock_notes.title: Forinthry/Daemonheim: autoheater + crafteneering
unlock_notes.summary: Equilibrium locks Daemonheim to Forinthry. Smithing autoheater (and advanced) is a token shop unlock with no GE substitute. Early Crafting crafteneering also lives inside Daemonheim. League planners treating Forinthry as combat-only will undersell artisan AFK quality.

unlock_notes.title: Anachronia: Orthen furnace core obtain + Iaia Crafting + Accidental FM
unlock_notes.summary: Orthen dig site supplies dragon burners for Orthen furnace core craft (99 Smithing / 102 Archaeology). Dream of Iaia hide workers are the highest Crafting XP-per-played-hour ironman route. Accidental Firemaking post-Extinction needs no log bank. Separate obtain (Anachronia) from use (global, best with Tirannwn Superheat Form).

unlock_notes.title: Smithing AFK trinity: Asgarnia workshop + Forinthry autoheater + Tirannwn Superheat Form (+ Anachronia core)
unlock_notes.summary: Burial XP is Asgarnia-local. Autoheater is Forinthry-token. Superheat Form is Tirannwn-quest/prayer. Orthen furnace core (Anachronia craft) removes Superheat Form drain and buffs efficiency. Full AFK burial stack is a four-region artisan combo, not a single-region pick.

unlock_notes.title: Curly roots ceiling is Karamja site + Tirannwn prayer
unlock_notes.summary: Do not list 670k FM XP/h curly roots as pure Karamja. Site is Jadinko Lair (Karamja); Superheat Form (or Always Adze) is the multiplier. Tirannwn also supplies Grace of the elves; Anachronia core is optional zero-drain. Without those, use the ~250-305k firepit baseline.

unlock_notes.title: Construction: Fort (Misthalin) + contracts + outfit (Morytania) + Prif restock (Tirannwn)
unlock_notes.summary: Fort Forinthry building is the structured early-mid path under working Misthalin taxonomy. Construction contracts are the ironman AFK bulk XP path. Constructor's outfit is Temple Trekking (Morytania). Prif estate agent / crystal teleports improve mahogany contract logistics. Miscellania hardwood (Fremennik) is the plank pipeline.

unlock_notes.title: Cooking: Desert fish + Misthalin Fort kitchen + Kandarin outfit/POF
unlock_notes.summary: Menaphos fish are Desert. Optimal cook XP needs Fort tier-3 kitchen (Misthalin working mapping) with player bonfires. Sous chef's outfit is Gnome Restaurant (Kandarin). Dairy ×4 XP needs Manor Farm totems (Kandarin). Cooking gauntlets (Family Crest) are an early multi-region quest priority.

unlock_notes.title: Crafting late game: Tirannwn harps vs Anachronia Iaia vs Misthalin Gate
unlock_notes.summary: Harps are AFK crystal-tool synergy in Tirannwn. Dream of Iaia wins XP-per-played-hour with Anachronia workers. Gate of Elidinis moonstones are a high active-AFK rate under Misthalin working taxonomy after Ode of the Devourer. Early game can lean Forinthry crafteneering without surface materials.

unlock_notes.title: Ironman artisan constraint: no portables
unlock_notes.summary: Portable workbenches and portable ranges cannot be used in Ironman Mode. All Construction/Cooking routes must assume permanent facilities (Fort, POH, Rogues' Den, Prif bonfires, etc.).
